dict.Din capital, în tabel (trebuie 100%): Of the capital, in the table (must be 100%)
dict.Impozit de reținut și de plătit la stat: Tax to withhold and pay to the state
dict.Impozitul se reține la plată și se decla: The tax is withheld on payment, then declared and paid by the 25th of the following month; check the rate with your accountant.
dict.Profitul net al anului împărțit asociați: The year's net profit split among the shareholders: the legal reserve (5%, at most 20% of the capital), losses to cover and what stays in the company are deducted automatically; for each shareholder you get the share of capital, the gross dividend, the withheld tax, the net amount and the tax deadline, and on the right what is still to be paid.
dict.Rămâne în firmă (alte rezerve, nereparti: Kept in the company (other reserves, undistributed)
dict.Repartizarea o aprobă asociații: Docs →: The shareholders approve the distribution: Docs → Resolution of the general meeting of shareholders or Decision of the sole shareholder.
dict.Rezerva legală de constituit (5%, cel mu: Legal reserve to set aside (5%, at most 20% of capital)
dict.Scrie profitul din situațiile financiare: Enter the profit from the financial statements and what stays in the company; dividends are split automatically by shares.
